description: Fresh capture-safe bound-variable renaming preserves exactly the free-variable set of the quantified formula.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderNormalForms.fresh_renaming_support.{u, v, u'} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {α : Type u'} [DecidableEq α] (φ : L.Formula α) (x y : α) (_hne : x ≠ y)
  (hy : y ∉ FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.freeVarFinset φ) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderNormalForms.bindVar
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderNormalForms.renameVar φ x y) y).freeVarFinset =
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderNormalForms.bindVar φ x).freeVarFinset
